geometry: fixed first eligible source/event anchor [T,T+H); never extended; seal only when analyzed frontier covers T+H
rationale: 50ms includes the exposed 40ms decoded Bach chord spread without putting its second note at an exclusive endpoint. 70/90/120ms are a small bounded increasing assembly family, not decoder thresholds. No candidate beyond these four is authorized.
selectionLexicographic: Non-baseline only: all declared dangerous advancement counters must equal zero at BOTH source rates on ALL development scenarios. Boundary-confounded witnesses remain counted and separately attributed; no output-dependent exclusion.
Maximize total one-to-one physically corroborated intended-attempt acceptances across both rates.
Choose the shorter H on ties.
ifNoneEligible: STOP: STEP_ACOUSTIC_ATTEMPT_ASSEMBLY_NOT_ESTABLISHED. No holdout execution, replacement candidate, detector or tuning.
developmentEvidence: backend/research/reports/step_decoded_sufficiency_v1/{acoustic.json,acoustic-seal.json,truth.json}; already exposed; both rates; 17 selected overlapping clips per rate, 3 SMD recordings
mandatoryBachProbe: In addition to unmodified complete development cells, replay every sealed s00-05 observation in fixed source interval [4250,4400)ms, retaining ALL pitches/IDs, readiness at 4250ms, target E4. E4@4260 plus G#4@4300 must not produce MATCH. This already-exposed causal probe contributes no extra usability denominator.
truthMatching: Existing first-anchor 35ms MIDI ground-truth grouping (not acoustic policy); one-to-one exact full physical pitch set within inclusive 100ms, maximize cardinality then minimize absolute anchor error. Also separately detect strict subset MATCH against nearest physical gesture within 100ms; never use target pitch to shift truth.
busyScenario: For busy_period_input and late_busy_publication only: deterministic 500ms post-seal analysis hold, a test-side busy interval not candidate geometry. All physical capture continues. No second attempt queue. Other scenarios finalize immediately when H is covered.
captureTimeline: Independent continuously advancing integer source-sample clock in replay, sampled when READY reopens. Publication availability schedules delivery only; it is not the semantic event timestamp or analysis-frontier watermark. Report captured-through source sample and session time separately.

holdoutSelectionRule.when: Only after exactly one H is selected and frozen; MIDI metadata first; no candidate output access.
holdoutSelectionRule.sources: Already-local SMD-piano_v2 paired recordings, lexical recordingId order, excluding ALL development recording IDs and audio/MIDI hashes. Not globally blind: previously used in AMT/Continuous work; engineering qualification only.
holdoutSelectionRule.occurrences: For each required family select its first MIDI-eligible occurrence across lexical eligible source IDs; no replacement. Duplicate source ranges may be merged using metadata only.
holdoutSelectionRule.caseRules: Existing MIDI tags for repeat/soft/rapid/guards. close_spread_chord = >=2 distinct note-ons with first-to-last spread in (0,35]ms. Extra/missing chord scenarios use the first real multi-note chord and a predeclared removed/added target pitch; no synthetic audio. Busy/late uses first consecutive truth groups <=600ms apart. Missing any family BLOCKS.
holdoutSelectionRule.context: 3.6s owned region centered with selected gesture 1.2s inside it, plus >=1.2s genuine source pre-roll and >=200ms genuine tail; require source bounds available and target >=600ms away from either owned edge. No padding or output-dependent shifting.
holdoutSelectionRule.truthIsolation: Stage A exposes only PCM/model/FIR/ORT/source chronology, one sequential production Worker/session. Complete acoustic output SHA256 seal before Stage B opens MIDI/targets.

usability: Report intended acceptance and latency separately. Safety-only zero obtained with zero corroborated singles or zero corroborated chords is SAFE_BUT_PRODUCT_USABILITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED, not promotion. No UX SLO claim.
